verdict.summary: The round-1 precedence defect is corrected soundly: legacy behavior now depends on presence of the `leases` key, so any supplied legacy source remains authoritative even when it yields no usable utilization values, while only a genuinely row-free input consults the collector aggregate. The added tests directly exercise missing, malformed, and empty legacy rows alongside a valid competing aggregate, so they would fail under the prior implementation and are non-vacuous. Aggregate validation rejects incomplete, incoherent, out-of-range, and non-numeric inputs, and the unconditional fatal salted-label check remains in force whenever legacy rows are present. The documentation matches the implemented migration contract.
